## Problem to solve
A clear description of the problem or gap this feature would address.
(e.g. "I always have to manually move tasks after creating them from the wrong column…")

## Proposed solution
Describe the feature you'd like. Include mockups or sketches if you have them.

## Alternatives considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've thought about.

## Additional context
Any other context, links to similar tools, or screenshots that help explain the idea.
